units.source_text: 大女公子定于四月初九日入冷泉院。

en.t: The elder young lady was scheduled to enter Reizei-in on the ninth day of the fourth month.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣派遣许多车辆及驱人前往供用。

en.t: Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, sent many carriages and attendants to be placed at her service.

units.source_text: 云居雁夫人怀恨在心，但念年来对这位异母姐虽然不甚亲近，

en.t: Lady Kumoi no Kari harbored resentment, but she reflected that although she had not been especially close to this half sister over the years,

units.source_text: 却为了藏人少将之事常常和她通信，

en.t: she had often exchanged letters with her because of the matter of the Chamberlain Lieutenant,

units.source_text: 如今忽然和她决绝，面子上不好看。

en.t: and it would look unseemly now to break with her all at once.

units.source_text: 因此送了许多高贵的妇女服装去，

en.t: Therefore she sent many fine garments for noblewomen,

units.source_text: 作为给侍女们的犒赏品。

en.t: to be used as rewards for the ladies in waiting.

units.source_text: 并附信云：“妹为小儿藏人少将精神失常，

en.t: She enclosed a letter saying, "Because my son, the Chamberlain Lieutenant, has become mentally disturbed,

units.source_text: 忙于照顾，未能前来襄助为歉。

en.t: I have been occupied with caring for him and regret that I could not come to assist you.

units.source_text: 吾姐不赐通知，太疏远我了。”

en.t: But for my elder sister not to inform me is to keep me far too distant."

units.source_text: 此信措辞稳重，而字里行间暗示不平之意，

en.t: The wording of this letter was restrained, yet between the lines it hinted at dissatisfaction,

units.source_text: 玉鬘尚侍看了心甚抱歉。

en.t: and Tamakazura, the Naishi no Kami, felt deeply sorry when she read it.

units.source_text: 夕雾右大臣也有信去，说道：

en.t: A letter also came from Yugiri, the Minister of the Right, saying:
"I should have come in person to offer my congratulations, but it happened to fall on a day of mourning,
and I regret that I could not do as I wished.

units.source_text: 今特派小儿前来充当杂役，

en.t: I have therefore specially sent my sons to serve as helpers,

units.source_text: 务请任意差遣，勿加顾虑为幸。”

en.t: and I would be grateful if you would use them freely without any hesitation."

units.source_text: 他派源少将及兵卫佐二子前往。

en.t: He sent his two sons, Gen Shosho and the Assistant Captain of the Left Division of Palace Guards.
